purpose: Quantify actual source-weighted signed and conservative unsigned contributions of original GE05 R1 high-phase bath nodes separately from original sampled FD4 derivative defect and first-order on-shell error budget. Do not tune source, phase thresholds, modes, quadrature, background or parameters to observations.
cohorts: Original C_min/C_star/C_max x Nt128,Nt64 x Nq2048,Nq1024, original left and right one-sided interval nodes, exact same Repair26 R1 trace and same original full history boundary.
original_D7r1_phase_bins_preserved: [0,.25),[.25,.5),[.5,1),[1,infinity); new pi split subdivides only old >=1 report-only bin.
exact_source: Original GE05 E_q10= -sqrt(w)/(2omega)*R, qx10=sqrt(w)/omega*i*kfund*m*z, full original six positive and six conjugate negative frequencies, signed +4 E_q10*qx10 Fourier convolution m0..40.
original_interval_R: Use exact frozen D13 implementation of both one-sided R_ODE and sampled FD4 temporal defect at same endpoints with original h_mid=tau*sqrt(H_i H_i+1); preserve full sampled R_FD4 and complex phase.
signed_phase_bin_requirement: For each bin and each original one-sided endpoint save signed complex W_ODE, signed complex W_FD4_defect and a noncancelling componentwise absolute-sum upper envelope over original bath nodes and conjugate mode pairings, with all original m0..40 time arrays. Saving only absolute bath per-node norms is insufficient to certify cancellation.
derived_identity: Across five bins, exact signed original W_ODE/W_defect must reconstruct frozen D13 original signed one-sided result. The bin-by-bin sum W_ODE + W_defect must reproduce frozen D13 sampled FD4 signed W at the corresponding side. These are machine identities only.
quadrature_diagnostics: Report Nq2048 vs Nq1024 left/right signed W for each phase bin and whole total, unsigned conservative envelope, and original sampled FD4 total. Retain relative and absolute differences on same original grid; no posthoc pass tolerance for physical smallness.
phase_diagnostics: Report raw per-bin node-interval counts and source-weighted signed and conservative unsigned envelopes. Counts alone cannot prove original high-phase contribution small.
original_archive_scope: D13 signed bath archive m0..40; no full Nyquist m41..64 bath diagnostic or source-consistent on-shell claim inferred.
